answer: The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, reset on any identity-link attempt, no identity may audit its own recruit. The orchard lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the voyage is where a second reviewer recomputes them. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. By the crystal of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
